name: Boulder foothills 3DEP mission backdrop

mapping.localX: east, centred on the sample-centre extent
mapping.localZ: south, centred on the sample-centre extent
mapping.localY: source elevation minus maximum source elevation plus 17 m; 1:1 relief, absolute datum removed
mapping.edgeTreatment: outer 150 m blends to representative procedural terrain
mapping.simulationEffect: visual only; no RF, routing, flight, or collision calculation uses this DEM

surfaceMaps: DEM-derived illustrative albedo, normals and roughness fade to the representative outer material; not orthoimagery or land-cover evidence
sceneProps: Deterministic illustrative scrub and rocks and a 50 m local-scale cue; no source-mapped vegetation, rocks, road or water
